purpose: Offers whose package quantity could not be confirmed against the original source. Nothing is corrected by guessing; the quantity stays as delivered and is marked quantity_status=unverified until the source confirms it.

flags.name: Coca Cola Cola 24 pk.
flags.conflicts_with: SuperBrugsen and Kvickly deliver the same product and price (79 kr) as 24 x 0.33 l = 7.92 l (9.97 kr/l)
flags.original_source: tilbudsugen.dk portal, partner page daglibrugsen-117, source_offer_id 11335752; Dagli'Brugsen flyer 40/2026, page 25
flags.evidence_for_as_delivered: Source record carries its own unit price 13.17 kr/l, which matches 6 l; container is empty (not 'can'); a 24 x 25 cl PET pack of Coca-Cola exists in the Danish market (seen in the dagligepriser.dk raw data for other chains).
flags.evidence_against: Same product text and price as the 24 x 0.33 l can pack at SuperBrugsen/Kvickly.
flags.not_confirmed_because: The portal page and the flyer image could not be opened from the working environment (network policy). No source text for the pack size is stored in the repository.
flags.needed_to_confirm: Open the flyer page (Dagli'Brugsen 40/2026, page 25) or the portal listing and read the pack text (24 x 25 cl or 24 x 33 cl).
